name: China Electronic Technology Group Corporation No. 11 Research Institute
zh: 中国电子科技集团公司第十一研究所
aliases: North China Research Institute of Electro-Optics (NCRIEO)

evidence.summary: The US Entity List names it as “China Electronic Technology Group Corporation No. 11 Research Institute”, one of the research institutes of China Electronics Technology Group Corporation (CETC). CETC is one of the state-owned defence-industry groups that SASTIND lists.
It belongs to CETC, which describes itself as a key state-owned enterprise administered directly by the central government.

sources.title: Addition of Certain Persons to the Entity List; and Removal of Certain Persons From the Entity List Based on Removal Requests (80 FR 44846, 28 July 2015)
